one_liner: 30-minute workshop that teaches math faculty with no web experience to build and deploy an interactive course app.
problem: Instructors want interactive teaching tools but lack web-development skills.
approach: Instructor-led walkthrough of a reference app in 5 steps, then tiered lab shells (guided, stats dashboard, open challenge), deployment to Streamlit Cloud, and a quick-reference sheet.
decision_relevance: Shows the ability to build analytic capacity in others by training colleagues to field their own tools.

headline_results.claim: Authored the workshop in the department org repo

limitations: Stale line-number map in the app header
Lab shells deliberately do not run until the blanks are filled
blockers_before_featuring: Archive demo_facdev or point it to the org repo
Optional: use ddof=1 or explain the difference; fix the header line map
